entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: ¶O *God of vengeances, Jehovah, *God of vengeances, shine forth;

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth, render the reward to the proud.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: How long shall the wicked, O Jehovah, how long shall the wicked triumph?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak insolence--all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: They crush thy people, O Jehovah, and afflict thine inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless,

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: And say, Jah will not see, neither will the God of Jacob regard [it].

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Understand, ye brutish among the people; and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He that instructeth the nations, shall not he correct--he that teacheth man knowledge?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: ¶Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jah, and whom thou teachest out of thy law;

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: For judgment shall return unto righteousness, and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: If Jehovah had not been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: When I said, My foot slippeth, thy loving-kindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: In the multitude of my anxious thoughts within me thy comforts have delighted my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: Shall the throne of wickedness be united to thee, which frameth mischief into a law?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They band together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But Jehovah will be my high tower; and my God the rock of my refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: And he will bring upon them their iniquity, and will cut them off in their own evil: Jehovah our God will cut them off.
